subject.title: GitHub OAuth consent still shows personal ClawdHub / steipete branding (reopen of #2524)

question: Should production GitHub authentication be moved now to an organization-owned ClawHub OAuth application, with the existing personal application retained only for rollback during validation?
rationale: Repository code cannot determine GitHub application ownership or rotate production credentials, and changing this authentication boundary requires an authorized operator with access to both GitHub and Convex production settings.

options.title: Move to organization ownership
options.body: Create or transfer an officially branded ClawHub OAuth application, rotate production credentials, validate every sign-in surface, and retain a short rollback window.

options.title: Temporarily retain personal ownership
options.body: Keep the existing application only if maintainers explicitly accept the trust and custody risk and document a dated migration plan.

recommendation.title: Move to organization ownership
recommendation.body: Create or transfer an officially branded ClawHub OAuth application, rotate production credentials, validate every sign-in surface, and retain a short rollback window.

likelyOwner.reason: This account was assigned to the exact predecessor and is the strongest available signal for ownership of the production follow-up.
